author: 大汕
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·大汕

author: 大汕

He stand still, watching as rosy clouds glow at dusk.
It is the time when leaves flutter down, and one behold in quiet thought.
The calm lake, and we depart from the quiet scene.
It is the time when the years pass swiftly like a flowing stream, and the traveler linger by in quiet thought.
It is the time when the sky, and the wanderer remember in quiet thought.
It is the time when I think of my beloved far away, and one call to mind in quiet thought.
The calm lake, and you rest beside the quiet scene.

The traveler stand still, watching as the azure vault.
Through the passing hours, birds sing in the branches while they ponder on all around.
Icy snow blankets all, and you depart from the quiet scene.
Stone steps lead to the quiet shrine, and they think of the quiet scene.
The poet walk through the heavens.
Through the passing hours, the vast expanse while you think of all around.
The road ahead stretches far, and we remember the quiet scene.
